additional_info.subject: RE: ID0397741-DC/Si-D/FR-[72So0g] Outlet OOO CRM:00798001652
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P6 170000686
Charger ID/Serial No.:
72So0g
Problem Description:
Outlets Out of Order and OCPP Router Replacement Activity
Please align for the site intervention to check the charger that is currently offline. First, investigate why the SCB router (XF3) is offline and verify that the power cables and SIM card are properly inserted. Then, use MobaXterm to ping all the components' IPs and identify which component’s IP is missing. Based on that, troubleshoot the necessary component's wiring.
Please ensure you carry one extra IMD, SECC, and a spare router. Below are the MLFB numbers for the relevant components:
8EM5903-0AA00-6AA3: SECC (Charge Controller CCS2 CHAdeMO AC)
8EM5903-0AA00-0AA1: IMD (Insulation Monitoring Device)
(Note: The MLFB for the router has already been shared in the earlier ticket [0397365], as it is related to the router issue of the same charger.)
If these components are not needed for this charger, they can be used for another charger that is experiencing issues with the SECC or IMD.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [06/07/2024], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
